title: Discharge Summary
key_sentences: The patient presented with five days of cough, fever and breathlessness.
Chest imaging showed right lower lobe consolidation and mild pulmonary congestion.
She was treated with oral amoxicillin and a short course of intravenous furosemide.
Her oxygen requirement settled by the fourth day and she walked unaided on the ward by the sixth.
Please weigh yourself every morning and call the ward if your weight rises by more than two kilograms in three days.
Return to the Emergency Department at once if you become short of breath at rest.

list_items.text: 2) Decompensated heart failure with preserved ejection fraction.
3) Type 2 diabetes mellitus, stable on oral treatment.
- Heart failure clinic in two weeks, with repeat blood tests the day before.
- Chest radiograph in six weeks to confirm resolution of the consolidation.
- Practice nurse to review the diabetes plan within one month.
Written information on heart failure given
